actions.label:

Wi-Fi
actions.command: bash -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && nmcli radio wifi on || nmcli radio wifi off'
actions.update_command: bash -c '[[ $(nmcli radio wifi) == enabled ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label:

Bluetooth
actions.command: bash -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && bluetoothctl power on || bluetoothctl power off'
actions.update_command: bash -c 'bluetoothctl show | grep -q "Powered: yes" && echo true || echo false'

actions.label:

Night Light
actions.command: bash -c 'if [[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]]; then nohup hyprsunset -t 4000 >/dev/null 2>&1 & else pkill hyprsunset; fi'
actions.update_command: bash -c 'pgrep -x hyprsunset >/dev/null && echo true || echo false'
